d:
A massive, towering demonic entity with a gargantuan, bloated grey-white body and a singular, massive red eye centered on the forehead. Features thick, stony grey skin and several protruding organic spikes across the torso. Possesses a thick, heavy grey tail ending in a blunt, club-like shape and small, vestigial wings. Four thick claws per hand.
BODY COLOR: grey-white
